start: Owner signed in, gym online, paid plan; AI Assistant open

steps.action: Type "Who has not paid?" in the box "Ask or give a task, in Hindi or English" and tap the arrow
user_sees: An answer card from the gym's own reports
How many questions are left today
must_not: A credit taken for a question
The member list sent to the AI

steps.action: Type "Send a holiday message to all members"
user_sees: A message card that does nothing until its button is tapped; the button shows the credits it uses
must_not: A message sent before the owner taps
Credits spent before Send

start: AI Assistant open; the owner speaks instead of typing

steps.action: Tap the microphone, say "kal gym band rahega, sabko batao" (under 30 seconds)
user_sees: The words appear as text, then a message card
must_not: The recording kept
A clip of over 30 seconds taken

start: AI Assistant; a message card is open

steps.action: Ask it to change the message: "chhota karo"
user_sees: The same card with a shorter message in English and Hindi
must_not: The message sent while rewriting
An empty message when the rewrite fails

user_sees: A card that opens "Import from Excel"
must_not: A page the AI invented
An owner-only page offered to the wrong person

steps.action: Tap the arrow with an empty box
must_not: A question used up

steps.action: Ask after the gym's daily questions are used
user_sees: "You have used today's free questions. Your credits are safe. Ask again tomorrow."
must_not: Credits taken
A red error

steps.action: Ask when the gym has no AI credits left
user_sees: "Your gym has no AI credits left. Tap your credits at the top to get more."
must_not: The question answered and charged anyway

steps.action: Open the demo gym and ask
user_sees: "The AI Assistant is not on in the demo gym."
must_not: The demo text sent to the AI
A long clip sent to the speech service

start: Owner of a gym in its free trial; AI Assistant open

steps.action: Ask after all trial gyms together reached this month's money cap
user_sees: "The AI Assistant is resting till next month. Everything else works as usual."
must_not: A paying gym stopped by the cap

steps.action: HQ pauses AI answers for the gym; ask
user_sees: "AI answers are paused for your gym. Write to MettleUp from Help to turn them back on."
must_not: The question answered while paused

user_sees: "The AI did not answer. Try again, or say it another way."
must_not: The question counted as used against the gym's credits

start: Owner types a request with a member's phone and email

steps.action: Type "Send Asha on 98765 43210, asha@x.com, a renewal reminder"
user_sees: The card shows the real phone and email back
must_not: The phone or email sent to the AI (it sees [PHONE_1] and [EMAIL_1])
Dues, visits or the member list sent to the AI

steps.action: A staff member opens the menu
must_not: A staff login getting answers (the server says "Only the owner can use the AI Assistant.")
